Thanks for the flag. Procurement ops here — we saw a small spike in rejected uploads earlier this week tied to PDFs that contain non-ASCII metadata (Mac-generated PDFs sometimes set application/octet-stream). Workday's ingest layer validates MIME types strictly.

Immediate actions we took:
- I pulled the vendor profile and manually uploaded the W9 provided by Sam to the vendor record (attached screenshot of vendor file list).
- Manually associated PO-12345 to the vendor so invoices route correctly.
- Enabled a temporary email intake: finance@redwood.com can accept vendor documents and we will upload them to Workday.

Longer-term: I'm opening a ticket with our Workday admin to relax the MIME validation for vendor uploads and to add clearer error messaging.

Sam — we completed the manual upload and associated your PO; please confirm you received an email confirmation from procurement@redwood.com.

Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
